name: Mao
source:
Age: Appears as 18
Specialization: Absolute Control
Main Element: Wind
Secondary Element: Fire
History: Mao is a mysterious half cat that sometimes appears before Lumen and talks to her.
Personality: Mao is cheerful and flirty, she is very true to her half cat apprentice and has a very cat-like personality
and tends to do whatever she likes.
